description: Adds optically guided jet-powered attack drones, aircraft launch rails, a six-drone Apex-6 ground launcher, a four-drone Apex-8 ground launcher, and parachute-deployed cargo swarms. Cargo pallets carry eight Apex-6 or four Apex-8 drones and are available on VL-49 Tarantula and the optional MC-260 Chimera mod. Includes upward drone ejection, sequential launches, and ammunition visuals. Requires Blueprinter 2.0.1 or newer.
